title: Pinned categorical comparisons for the fixed geometric overlap
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit cocone c, i≤j, and t:Z→Spec(R_i) locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Assume shared derived categories for all schemes and localized-open sites [def-pc-derived-category]. Put Yj=Z×Spec(R_j), X=Z×Spec(c.pt) and gj:X→Yj. Let U,V be compact opens covering Yj, A and B perfect objects on U and V, E in D(X), and phiU and phiV the supplied isomorphisms of their limit pullbacks with exact restrictions of E [def-pc-perfect-overlap-hom-continuity-data]. Set W=(U intersection V).toScheme, s=W.ι followed by Yj→Spec(R_j), and objects(false)=L(W→U)*A, objects(true)=L(W→V)*B [def-pc-derived-pullback]. There are comparison data at every k≥j, of exactly perfectOverlapComparisonDataType, whose theta equations retain the supplied phi. For the actual categories Ck=D((f_kj inverse U intersection f_kj inverse V).toScheme), objects Fk=SU(Ak),SV(Bk), functors Gk=HWk and pinned psi to O(false)=O(true)=RW(E), there are categorical equivalences stageEquiv(k):Ck≌D(W×Spec(R_k)) and apexEquiv:D(localized intersection site)≌D(W×Spec(c.pt)); object isomorphisms sigma(k,b):stageEquiv(k)(Fk(b))≅Lp_k*(objects(b)) and rho(b):apexEquiv(O(b))≅Lp_infinity*(objects(b)); For every f:Fk(a)→Fk(b), conjugation of apexEquiv(psi(k,a) inverse followed by Gk(f) followed by psi(k,b)) by rho(a),rho(b) equals perfectLimitMap applied to conjugation of stageEquiv(k)(f) by sigma(k,a),sigma(k,b) [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. No geometric finiteness proof, perfectness proof, Hom equivalence, Hom identity/composition law, or Hom continuity is asserted. The hstage binder only states that some k≥j exists for each pair of opens; j itself suffices.

proof.text: Apply the proved perfect_overlap_object_realization_core_data theorem. Unfold the adopted source core proposition. The core already contains the fixed stage and apex equivalences, object isomorphisms, transition functors, their pinned base comparisons, natural comparison and object equations; no separate geometric construction is needed in this module.

Prove pinned_conjugation by cancelling the source and target object isomorphisms and using naturality of the functor comparison. Apply it to the core object equations. Expand Iso.homCongr and functor maps of psi, and use core.transition_pin to obtain exactly the required perfectLimitMap equation. This is the complete private theorem perfect_overlap_object_realization_hom_pin.

Map the nonempty dependent pair under Nonempty.map. For its core, construct PerfectHomObjectRealization fieldwise using completePerfectHomObjectRealization and the proved Hom pin, then pair it with the same comparison-data family. Delta-reduce only the target proposition, retaining its local definitions. This preserves every supplied local identification and every stage, apex and object comparison without repeatedly substituting the full geometric expressions.

theorem perfect_overlap_object_realization
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (t : Z ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation t] [QuasiCompact t] [QuasiSeparated t]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (Z : Scheme.{u}) (U : Z.Opens),
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (j : I) (hij : i ≤ j)
    (hstage : ∀ (U V : (pullback t (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE hij)))).Opens),
      ∃ k : I, j ≤ k)
    : perfectOverlapObjectRealizationStatement R c hc i Z t j hij hstage
